summary: PARTIAL is correct. Proposals (a), (b) and (d) are implemented. (a): the gate unlocks on the published `authenticated`, and the directory read is prefetched beside restoreSession instead of after it. (b): an 8 s launch decision deadline in the gate plus an 8 s bearer access-decision deadline in the controller. (d): the native splash is held up to 800 ms for the gate decision. I found no implementation of (c), the read-only cached workspace on a transient Hub failure, in any module, renamed file or Hub change. Offline launches with a stored token still land on the locked identity screen. One small waterfall the auditor missed also remains: on a 401 restore, the gate still waits for a DPoP-signed bootstrap-availability probe whose answer no mobile screen reads.

evidence.note: deriveAppAccess unlocks on hostedSessionRevalidated alone (proposal a). `locked` still needs both planes hydrated and no grant, so an `unavailable` account with no direct credential is locked (line 40). At f1be4abc7 it returned hydrating until hostedHydrated.

The 8 s HOSTED_LAUNCH_DECISION_DEADLINE_MS timer sets hostedHydrated (proposal b), and hostedAuthenticated feeds hostedSessionRevalidated. The locked branch renders LockedNavigation, whose Access screen is NativeIdentityScreen.

#restoreAccess prefetches listNodes beside restoreSession (:753, prefetchHostedDirectory :470-486). It publishes `authenticated` and runs accessSettled before #refreshDirectoryWith (:773). The serial directory RTT is off the critical path.
HOSTED_ACCESS_CHECK_DEADLINE_MS = 8_000. In bearer mode `unavailable` is published at the deadline with the retry armed, and the request keeps its full deadline so a late answer is still adopted.
SplashScreenCoordinator holds the splash until markAppAccessDecided, capped at SPLASH_ACCESS_DECISION_WAIT_MS = 800 (proposal d).

Residual the auditor missed. The mobile gate settles on hostedHubController.bootstrap(), not bootstrapAccess(). On a 401 (expired or revoked stored session), #restoreAccess clears the token, then awaits getBootstrapAvailability (api.ts:904, dpop: 'mint', so another Secure Enclave signature plus an RTT) before publishing signed-out. The gate stays on the launch surface for that extra request, capped at 8 s.
The only mobile reader of bootstrapAvailable is deriveHostedSignInView, and no non-test mobile screen imports it. runtime.ts:452 itself says no mobile surface reads the probe's answer.

The offline or early-deadline locked surface is the saved-session view ('Reaching your Hub…', or 'still checking' while the launch check is pending, added in #710). It is not hostedAuthModel's 'Hub unavailable' string, which the auditor cited. No cached workspace and no read-only variant exist, so (c) is not implemented.
Policy unchanged since f1be4abc7: the workspace navigator mounts only after a revalidated native Hub session or a readable direct credential.

Precedent for (c). Hosted web already shows an opt-in ('Remember this browser') read-only cached preview while accountStatus is `unavailable` or the bootstrap check is pending, with mutations gated on full revalidation. Mobile has no equivalent.
Mobile cache policy keeps hosted content across session expiry (purged only on explicit sign-out), so cached content for (c) exists on disk.

remaining: (1) Main item, proposal (c), needs sign-off. With a stored hosted bearer token and a transient access failure (offline, timeout, 5xx; accountStatus `unavailable`, or still `signed-out` while the check is pending), deriveAppAccess returns `locked` (apps/mobile/src/features/access/appAccessModel.ts:40). AppAccessGate.tsx:158-160 then shows NativeIdentityScreen's 'Reaching your Hub…' view instead of the cached workspace, although the snapshot cache and Hub roster are retained on disk (environmentSnapshotPersistence.ts:310-314). (2) Minor, missed by the auditor. On an expired or revoked stored session, the gate waits for the DPoP-signed /api/auth/bootstrap-status probe (state.ts:783-788) after the 401 answer is known. This costs one extra RTT and one Secure Enclave signature before the sign-in surface, for an answer no mobile screen reads (only hostedAuthModel.ts:432, which is unused by screens). It is bounded by the 8 s gate deadline.
fixDefects: No real defects in (a), (b) or (d). One correction to the auditor's timing quirk: the gate's 8 s timer starts at mount, before the controller's bearer decision deadline, so the gate can decide `locked` while accountStatus is still the initial `signed-out`. This does not flash a sign-in form or 'Hub unavailable'. NativeIdentityScreen passes checking=true until ensureMobileHostedSession settles, and deriveSavedHubSessionView then shows 'Reaching your Hub… still checking your saved sign-in' (savedHubSessionModel.ts:68-83). A late `authenticated` still unlocks. This is intended behaviour.
implementationSketch: (c), after sign-off. Mirror hosted web's canShowHostedReadPreview (apps/web/src/hostedHub/readCache.ts:614) in the mobile gate. (1) appAccessModel.ts: add a fact, e.g. `hostedCachedPreviewAvailable`, plus a new verdict { status: "unlocked", via: "hosted-cached-preview" } or a separate `preview` status. Return it only when no plane grants access, hostedHydrated is true, and the preview fact holds; `locked` keeps priority over it once the Hub gives a definite session answer. (2) AppAccessGate.tsx: compute the fact from (a) a stored bearer token (mobileSessionCredentials.readBearerToken, presentation-only today), (b) a non-empty cached Hub roster (getCachedHubNodeRoster / subscribeCachedHubNodeRoster) and (c) accountStatus === 'unavailable' or (initial 'signed-out' while the launch check is pending). Clearing the token on a 401 must drop the preview and re-lock. (3) In the preview, mount WorkspaceNavigation with a 'Reconnecting to Hub' banner driven by accessRecoveryPending. Audit composer, outbox drain, terminals, files and git entry points so none can mutate. They already require a ready directory or a live connection plus a fresh shell snapshot, but check that queued outbox sends stay in the queue, and that ServerStateBootstrap and the hosted connection coordinator do not request relay tickets while unauthenticated. (4) Tests: appAccessModel.test.ts cases for preview-on-unavailable, re-lock on a definite 401 or sign-out, upgrade to via 'hosted-session' on recovery, and no preview without a roster or token. (5) Update docs/mobile-native-status.md:21-24 and the cache section of docs/unified-workspace.md. (2) Minor probe waterfall: let native runtimes skip the bootstrap-availability probe, e.g. a controller or runtime-configuration flag set by configureMobileHostedRuntime that makes the session-failure branch at state.ts:780-789 publish { ...initialState } at once. Alternatively, call accessSettled before the probe and have the gate await a new ensureMobileHostedAccessDecided() that resolves on hostedHubController.bootstrapAccess() rather than bootstrap(). Keep web behaviour unchanged, because web reads bootstrapAvailable for first-run. Test in packages/client-runtime/src/authorization (state tests): with the flag set, a 401 restore publishes signed-out without calling getBootstrapAvailability.
decisionReason: (c) reverses a documented auth-gate rule (docs/mobile-native-status.md:21-24: the workspace mounts only after a revalidated native Hub session). It also shows account-scoped cached content on the strength of a stored token whose session the Hub has not confirmed. That is a product and security trade-off that touches the hosted lifecycle and mutation-readiness ownership in AGENTS.md, so it needs explicit sign-off. Hosted web's opt-in remembered-browser preview is a precedent, but mobile would turn it on by default. The minor probe skip changes no auth semantics and needs no decision.
correction: The status is right. Detail corrections: (1) The offline locked surface is NativeIdentityScreen's saved-session view ('Reaching your Hub…', savedHubSessionModel.ts), not hostedAuthModel.ts:468/623's 'Hub unavailable'. deriveHostedSignInView is not used by any mobile screen, and :623 is the no-Hub-build case. (2) The cited timing quirk is not a locked-screen or sign-in flash: the `checking` view added in #710 covers it. (3) Missed residual: the mobile gate awaits bootstrap(), not bootstrapAccess(), so after a 401 restore it still waits for a DPoP-signed bootstrap-availability probe whose answer mobile never reads.
